Author: TheKHD5
Name: Bestiary Nav
Description: Click a Bestiary entry to find its capture location or duty. Highlight nearby uncaptured beasts and optionally travel to them with Lifestream and vnavmesh. /bnav opens the Bestiary; /bnav config opens settings.
Changelog:
- Optionally wait for full HP before new Capture and Levelling pulls.
- Keep Levelling targets within your current level offsets and leave unsuitable areas.
- Skip areas where a full patrol finds no matching enemies.
- Recover stalled combos despite pet damage, preserving the next basic combo step.
- Show target ranges and combat recovery details in diagnostics.

Full details on GitHub repo:
